name: IDS Courier
notes: Inter District Shipping (IDS). Office-to-office — pay at the courier when you collect. Rates follow IDS package sizes; Central and Northern districts share the same price.

name: EZY Courier
notes: Reliable nationwide service. Typical 2–4 business days after dispatch. Office-to-office: collect at the courier office in your area. Shipping is paid directly at the courier — rates below are approximate guides.
